title: Lavrov: Ukraine Does Not Deserve Ceasefire 'Respite'
detail: Russian Foreign Minister Sergei Lavrov declared that Ukraine does not deserve the 'respite' a ceasefire would bring, signaling a continued hardline Russian negotiating position and rejecting Western calls for a pause in fighting.

title: NATO Supreme Commander: Alliance Will Destroy 'Everything' if Russia Attacks Member State
detail: NATO's Supreme Allied Commander Europe warned Russia that the alliance would destroy 'everything' in response to any attack on a NATO member state, escalating deterrence rhetoric as the Ukraine war continues. The warning is aimed at deterring potential Russian escalation beyond Ukrainian borders.

title: German Chancellor Merz: Russia Will Only Negotiate Under Significant Pressure
detail: German Chancellor Friedrich Merz stated that Russia will only come to the negotiating table if placed under significant pressure, adding EU diplomatic weight to Western calls for a harder stance on Ukraine support. His remarks reinforce the position that military and economic pressure must continue to achieve a negotiated settlement.
